As your processing and power systems develop, you can prepare portable equipment and plan a journey to Prosperity. Two branches begin here:

§5Portable Equipment§r
Progress from the LM12 through the T20, QLZ04, and Project 107, learning about LV, MV, HV, and EV weapons and their ammunition. Preparing all three regular ammo packs unlocks a one-time choice of one mimic ammo pack.

§dExploring Prosperity§r
Prepare the Spacetime Singularity Calibration Engineering and a charged Anchor Beacon, then mark a safe return point before departure. The six feedstock quests introduce their industrial uses and only require matching filled fluid cells; building production lines is not required.

§3Read this introduction and check it off to continue either branch.§r
